## p7c Rebuild Cube Session Table Index — Dry Run with Forced Locking

```bash
p7c rebuild-cube-session-index --dry-run --force-lock
```

## Flag Breakdown

| Flag | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `--dry-run` | Performs a **simulation** of the rebuild. It calculates the expected workload, estimated time, and affected rows **without** modifying any data or acquiring locks on live tables. Useful for planning and capacity estimation. |
| `--force-lock` | **Ignores** any existing locks or lock conflicts that would normally prevent the rebuild. It forcibly acquires an exclusive lock on the cube session table, even if the table is currently in use by other sessions. |

## What Happens Under the Hood

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  --dry-run                                             │
│  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────│
│  • Parses the cube session table schema                 │
│  • Calculates the number of rows to rebuild             │
│  • Estimates CPU and I/O cost                           │
│  • Outputs a "dry-run report" (no changes applied)      │
│  • Exits with status 0 regardless of actual cost        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  --force-lock                                          │
│  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────│
│  • Attempts to acquire EXCLUSIVE lock on the table      │
│  • If a lock is already held by another session,        │
│    it **waits** (not just fails) until the lock is      │
│    released, even if that blocks long-running queries   │
│  • Bypasses the default timeout threshold (default: 60s)│
│  • Prevents partial index rebuilds due to lock races    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## When to Use This Combination

| Scenario | Use Case |
|----------|----------|
| **Pre-staging** | Verify how long the rebuild will take before scheduling it during maintenance window |
| **Orphaned sessions** | Force a rebuild when the table is locked by dead or hung sessions |
| **Corrupted index** | Bypass lock contention to fix a corrupted index quickly |
| **Capacity planning** | See the estimated cost without risking production disruption |

## Example Dry-Run Output

```
$ p7c rebuild-cube-session-index --dry-run --force-lock

=== CUBE SESSION TABLE INDEX REBUILD (DRY RUN) ===
